_comment: StandardPartSelector — catalogue anglais (clé plate). Généré depuis translations.json (voir _legacy/).
catalog_editor_tip: Open the catalog editor to add or modify components
ctx_free_detail: No object selected — component will be placed at origin
ctx_lcs_detail: Position and orientation taken from the coordinate system — no diameter filtering
ctx_tooltip_free_detail: No object selected — component placed at origin.
ctx_tooltip_geo_detail:
An arc or circle is selected — component centered on geometry,
  catalog filtered by diameter.
ctx_tooltip_nonsc_detail:
A Body or Part without SC_ properties is selected — the wizard
  offers to register it in the catalog as a new standard.
ctx_tooltip_replace_detail:
A standard component (SC_) is selected — choose
  a new reference to replace it in place.
doc_partial_completed: Document '{document}' fully loaded: it was only partially loaded, your changes will now be saved.
doc_partial_no_file: Document '{document}' is partially loaded and has no file: it cannot be completed, write refused.
doc_partial_remains: Document '{document}' is still PARTIALLY loaded: FreeCAD would save nothing and would not recompute it. Write refused. Open that file directly (File > Open), then try again. {erreur}
ed_err_columns_min_required: At least one non-mute column is required.
ed_err_invalid_name_path_sep: The name must not contain a path separator.
ed_err_name_taken_msg:
A file "{new_name}" already exists for this component.
Choose another name.
ed_label_columns_help:
Check the parameters to show in the selection table.
Mute: saved in the JSON but not applied to the VarSet.
Required: if unchecked, an empty value for this parameter is
omitted from the JSON for that reference, instead of being
stored as an empty string.
ed_label_csv_mapping_help: Map each CSV column to its role in the catalog:
ed_label_from_family_header:
Family: {family}  —  {count} existing reference(s) (greyed out)
Add new rows. The variant name = the entered reference.
ed_label_library_help:
Library directory for FCStd files.
Expected structure: <library>/<family>/models/<file>.FCStd

When the path changes, existing FCStd files can be moved.
ed_label_refs_help:
Enter the references.
• 'Reference' column: reference name (e.g. P20x100)
• Other columns: parameter values (pre-filled from the VarSet)
• 'Favorite' column: check for components to spot quickly
  (already used, in stock…) — shown bold in the table.
• Duplicate a row to create a similar variant.
ed_label_varset_help: VarSet: the CSV name becomes the label shown in the selector (the column keeps the VarSet key internally). Editable later in the editor — page 2/5.
ed_msg_fcstd_orphan_offer:
"{old_name}" is no longer used here, but still exists in {where}.

As long as a copy stays in the library, it will be automatically re-copied locally on every macro launch.
ed_note_lib_orphan: ⚠ "{old_name}" is no longer used but is still present in {where}.
ed_note_lib_still_exists: ⚠ "{old_name}" still exists in {where}: as long as it stays in the library, it will be re-synced locally on every macro launch.
ed_ph_variant_label: Optional — text shown in the selector, e.g. 'Polished A2 stainless'
ed_q_migration_msg:
Move the FCStd files from:
{src}
to:
{dst}?
ed_status_config_removed: Configuration removed — local FCStd files will be used.
ed_status_empty_path: Empty path. Use 'Delete config' to disable.
ed_status_fcstd_copied_lib_renamed: FCStd copied (from library) under new name → {new_name}
ed_tooltip_import_csv: Import references from a CSV file
ed_tooltip_move_col_left: Move the selected column to the left
ed_tooltip_move_col_right: Move the selected column to the right
edit_model_tip:
Opens the FCStd file in FreeCAD for editing.
After editing, save the file and refresh the thumbnail.
editor_addcol_tip: Add a data column outside the VarSet (Price, Supplier…)
editor_columns_help:
Check the parameters to show in the selection table.
Extra columns (outside the VarSet) are added from the References tab, via « + Column ».
editor_csv_map_footnote: VarSet: the CSV name becomes the label shown in the selector (the column keeps the VarSet key internally). Editable afterwards in the editor — page 2/5.
editor_csv_map_help: Match each CSV column to its role in the catalog:
editor_csv_tip: Import references from a CSV file
editor_data_help:
Enter the references.
• 'Reference' column: reference name (e.g. P20x100)
• Other columns: parameter values (pre-filled from the VarSet)
• Duplicate a row to create a similar variant.
editor_lib_cleared: Configuration cleared — local FCStd files will be used.
editor_lib_empty_path: Empty path. Use 'Clear configuration' to disable.
editor_lib_help:
Library directory for FCStd files.
Expected structure: <library>/<family>/models/<file>.FCStd

When changing the path, existing FCStd files can be moved.
editor_lib_migrate_prompt:
Move the FCStd files from:
{src}
to:
{dst}?
editor_msg_need_column: At least one non-mute column is required.
filter_tolerance_tip: Numeric tolerance: show values within ±5% of the target
integration_ask_msg:
The component "{label}" is not a registered standard.

Do you want to save it as a private standard?
integration_success_msg:
Component saved to Standards/.
The original model has been marked as standard (SC_).
You can refine it in the catalog editor.
integration_warn_no_varset:
⚠ This component has no VarSet.
It will be integrated as a fixed shape (non-parametric).
You can add a VarSet later in FreeCAD.
no_fcstd_for_variant: No FCStd file associated with this variant.
orient_no_geo: No geometry selected — component inserted at origin
ph_family: Select or type a new family...
ph_ref: Select or type a new variant...
ph_type: Select or type a new type...
placement_note:
Note: these resets apply only to
the exported FCStd. The source document is not modified.
refresh_thumb_tip:
Deletes the cached thumbnail.
It will be re-extracted from the FCStd on next display.
replace_tip: Replace the selected component with the chosen reference
sc_edit_or_new_prompt:
The selection belongs to standard component '{ref}'.

Do you want to edit this component, or create a new one?
sc_modified_prompt:
The VarSet of '{ref}' differs from the catalogue.
JSON editor will be available in a future update.
sc_nonstandard_prompt:
Component '{ref}' does not match any reference (proposed name: {auto_name}).
Convert to standard?
update_fcstd_alert: These components' FCStd model has changed. An in-place update is not possible: recreate them with the new FCStd (delete then reinsert, or use Replace).
update_missing_alert: The following components cannot be updated (reference missing from catalog):
update_no_varset: VarSet not found — recreate the component
update_nothing_to_do: All components are up to date.
update_tip: Update obsolete components in the document
update_varset_alert: These components' catalog values have changed (parameters and/or extra data). The update is applied in place, without moving the part or breaking the assembly.
